angularDiameterSource: Computed here from the record's radius and distance: 2 x 375,678 km at 66.85 pc = 0.08 mas. No interferometric diameter of this star is used.
distanceSource: Gaia DR3 parallax 14.9578 +/- 0.0155 mas (same row, RUWE 1.16): 66.85 pc, no zero-point correction
radiusSource: Radius 0.54 +/- 0.03 solar radii from Osborn et al. 2026, the stellar radius of the default parameter set of TOI-672 b in the NASA Exoplanet Archive (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2026A&A...709A..23O/abstract): 375,678 km at 695,700 km per solar radius. Mass 0.54 +/- 0.03 solar masses from Osborn et al. 2026, the stellar mass of the default parameter set of TOI-672 b in the NASA Exoplanet Archive (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2026A&A...709A..23O/abstract); GM is that mass times the JPL solar GM. Temperature 3810 +/- 33 K from Osborn et al. 2026, the stellar temperature of the default parameter set of TOI-672 b in the NASA Exoplanet Archive (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2026A&A...709A..23O/abstract). presentationUp: the display axis is a sky-plane convention; the spin axis's position angle on the sky is not measured.
effectiveTemperatureSource: Osborn et al. 2026, the stellar temperature of the default parameter set of TOI-672 b in the NASA Exoplanet Archive (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2026A&A...709A..23O/abstract)
surfaceGravitySource: log g from the mass and radius in packages/astronomy/data/bodies/toi-672.json (sources in its physicalNotes), log10(GM/R^2) in cgs: 4.706, rounded to two decimals
spectralTypeSource: NASA Exoplanet Archive, composite parameters of TOI-672 (pscomppars): spectral type M0 V, from Osborn et al. 2026 (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2026A&A...709A..23O/abstract)
metallicitySource: NASA Exoplanet Archive, composite parameters of TOI-672 (pscomppars): [Fe/H] -0.14 dex, from Osborn et al. 2026 (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2026A&A...709A..23O/abstract)
luminositySource: NASA Exoplanet Archive, composite parameters of TOI-672 (pscomppars): log10 of the luminosity in solar units -1.31885, from Osborn et al. 2026 (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2026A&A...709A..23O/abstract)
ageSource: Gaia DR3 FLAME (Creevey et al. 2023, A&A 674, A26), astrophysical_parameters of Gaia DR3 5396580575830873728, flags_flame 00: age_flame 11.150886 Gyr (16th to 84th percentiles 6.060696 to 13.5)
rotationPeriodSource: NASA Exoplanet Archive, composite parameters of TOI-672 (pscomppars): rotation period 18.5 d, from Osborn et al. 2026 (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2026A&A...709A..23O/abstract)
projectedRotationSpeedSource: NASA Exoplanet Archive, composite parameters of TOI-672 (pscomppars): projected rotation speed 3.75 km/s, from Osborn et al. 2026 (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2026A&A...709A..23O/abstract)

shape.qualification: A sphere at the published radius, colored from the star's Gaia DR3 BP/RP spectrum (photometry/stellar-color.json); no image of the photosphere exists.
